scope: Targeted current-source held-lock cancellation controls; no deployment acceptance
assertions: Closed scheduled healthy cancellation remains neutral without rate refund or success
Known transport, HTTP and chain identity negatives retain quarantine during metadata lock contention
Generic and incomplete half-open cancellation keep quarantine
Known wrong or malformed identity remains typed across getter deadline
Clipped identity probe deadline preserves known typed integrity
Own attempt timeout remains failure when recording is cancelled; exactly one failure
metadata_policy: No credentials, raw bodies, actor identifiers, private endpoint URLs or operational location metadata
